title: Fire hose
terrain: flat ground z=0 + fire_hose.usd (hose, hydrant, retracting stands)

physical_hose.note: 9.4 m chain hose (47 capsule links; mass user-defined), tail fixed to the hydrant; starts in Y stands that sink into the floor from frame 420. PhysX starts all hose joints at 0 (straight): write hose.json init_joint_pos_rad after reset.

rubber_hand.grip: left palm under / right palm over the hose (flat palms)

dex3.grip: power grasp, tug-of-war style: fingers wrap the hose; Dex3-1 finger torque 1.4 N*m (thumb_0 2.45)
